services.name: The Magic Tour
services.desc: Experience a romantic twilight tour around Orlando! Distance 35 miles Private Tour - $225 Public Tour $199 About A magical tour taking you around the perimeter of the Disney Magic Kingdom! Enjoy the breathtaking view of several beautiful lakes dotting the central Florida landscape and fly past beloved parks and landmarks including Disney Springs, Animal Kingdom, Blizzard Beach, Old Town, ESPN Wide World of Sports, and All-Star Resort - plus much more. An unforgettable view of the best of Orlando! More Info Confirmation will be received at the time of booking. 2 passenger minimum up to 4 Up to Four Passengers • 35 Miles • Private Tours Available! • From $150!

services.name: Epic Tour
services.desc: See famous theme parks and attractions like never before! Distance 20 miles About Enjoy a bird’s-eye view of Orlando as you take to the skies for a helicopter flight past beloved theme parks! This 20-mile tour flies around all the attractions of both the Disney Springs and Spectacular tours, as well as by SeaWorld, Discovery Cove, and Aquatica, where waterslides plunge through dolphin enclosures! In the comfort of an air-conditioned, professionally piloted helicopter, you’ll see your favorite parks like never before! More Info Confirmation will be received at the time of booking. 2 passenger 20 Miles • Private Tours Available!

services.name: Grand Park Adventure Tour
services.desc: Come see the sites of Orlando on a thrilling aerial adventure! Distance 30 miles About This tour truly delivers it all! Your helicopter adventure takes you around all the attractions of the previous tours – Old Town, ESPN Wide World of Sports, Animal Kingdom, Epcot, SeaWorld, Discovery Cove, and Aquatica - but also flies around Icon Park, Island of Adventure, Universal Studios, City Walk, Volcano Bay, Magical Midway, and Big Sand Lake! In the comfort of an air-conditioned, professionally piloted helicopter, this tour is a VIP aerial adventure! More Info Confirmation will be received at the 30 Miles • Private Tours Available!
